Employer Block, Inc.

Job Title Partner Engineer

Job Location Oakland, CA

Job Duties

• Partner with the Partnerships team to support and grow strategic integrations on Square's platform.
• Lead technical discovery and solution design for complex partner integrations.
• Drive integration quality across engagements (reliability, scalability, maintainability).
• Act as the Partner Engineering technical lead setting direction, guiding prioritization, and supporting day-to-day execution.
• Get into the weeds on complex integrations and act as an escalation point when needed.
• Identify patterns across partner integrations and work with Product to improve platform capabilities.
• Coach and support other Solutions Engineers, helping raise the bar on technical quality and solutioning.
• 20% domestic travel is required.
• May telecommute.

Job Requirements Employer will accept a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field and 5 years of experience in the job offered or in a Partner Engineer-related occupation.

Salary Range $225,000.00 USD Annual

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.
